findings.session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing a safe, practical framework for addressing transport anxiety. The mentor and student identified the main barrier as uncertainty regarding an approved alternative route and anxiety about a specific crossing. A between-session task was agreed upon (recording journey times), but no external support (e.g., formal transport assessment or route verification) has been delivered yet.

tracked_details.detail: Main barrier: Uncertainty about whether an approved alternative route exists; anxiety regarding a specific crossing point.
Intended intervention: Transport Assessment to identify safer routes or entitlements.
Delivered activity: Mapping the usual route and identifying difficult points (connection) during the session.
Agreed between-session task: Record two actual journey times before the next meeting.
Student preference: School-based next steps rather than home-based solutions; avoiding sharing private family details in records.

findings.conclusion: The initial session successfully established a collaborative, non-judgmental approach. While the mentor and student mapped the current route difficulties during the meeting (delivered activity), the primary intended intervention (formal Transport Assessment/Route Verification) remains pending with no evidence of receipt. The main barrier (uncertainty about the route) persists. The agreed between-session task (recording journey times) is pending. Evidence does not support improvement in the main barrier or attendance yet, as this is the first session.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up session focused on reviewing a completed between-session task (recording journey times) and conducting an in-session activity comparing recorded times with the timetable. The student confirmed completion of the agreed task but reported that the wider barrier (uncertainty about route approval/safety) remains unresolved. No external support (e.g., formal transport assessment or route verification) has been delivered yet.

The student reported that while the specific step was manageable, the main barrier regarding route uncertainty and safety remains unresolved. findings.session_summary: Session 3 focused on reviewing the status of an agreed between-session task (checking an alternative departure) and conducting a new in-session activity to list school transport-assistance contacts. The student reported uncertainty regarding whether they completed the previous task exactly as planned, noting they did not write down what happened for a specific difficult day. A new activity was attempted within the session (listing contacts), which the student found useful but noted they could not yet repeat alone. The main barrier remains unresolved.
